messages.content: An FDM slicer prints with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.4 mm perimeter line width, 3 perimeters, 0.2 mm layer height (including the first layer) and 5 solid top layers. What are the total single-side wall thickness in mm and the top solid shell thickness in mm for a vertical wall? Return only JSON of the form {"answer": {"wallThicknessMm": ..., "topThicknessMm": ...}}.

Approximating extrusion cross-section as line_width * layer_height, what is the maximum print speed in mm/s for a 0.45 mm line width and 0.2 mm layer height when the hotend's maximum volumetric flow rate is 13.5 mm^3/s? The answer is an integer. Return only JSON of the form {"answer": ...}.

Choose one filament from ["PLA", "ASA", "PVA"] for a rigid outdoor sensor bracket exposed to direct summer sun and UV, where glass-transition temperature (~100 C vs ~60 C for PLA) and weather resistance are required. Return only JSON of the form {"answer": "..."}.
Choose one filament from ["PLA", "TPU-95A", "PA6-Nylon"] for a flexible vibration-damping landing skid that must absorb impact shocks without cracking. Return only JSON of the form {"answer": "..."}.

A cylindrical steel dowel pin has a 6.0 mm diameter. In a 3D CAD model for FDM printing, a through-hole requires a 0.2 mm radial clearance on all sides so the pin slides freely. What modelled hole diameter in mm should be specified? Return only JSON of the form {"answer": ...}.

A printed ABS bar shrinks uniformly by 0.8 percent on cooling (L_final = L_scaled * (1 - 0.008)). Using the linear slicer compensation approximation L_scaled = L_target * (1 + 0.008), what scaled CAD length in mm is needed for a 125 mm target bar? Return only JSON of the form {"answer": ...}.
